run_process_entry: run the launchpad PythonNode worker entry point with task id and data file flags
parse_process_entry_flags: parse and consume launchpad process entry flags returning unconsumed argv
get_task_id: get the current task id from flags or vertex ai cluster spec environment
run_main_worker: run the main worker function loading init and data pickle files then executing the task function
run_parse_flags_and_run: run parse_flags_and_run to parse flags and execute the main worker via absl app.run
